info.name: Losant Application Experience API
info.description:
Manage Losant Applications, the top-level container for IoT solutions, plus dashboards, events, webhooks, integrations, files, audit logs, credentials, certificates, application keys, API tokens, and resource jobs. Derived from the Losant Platform API (Bravado/Swagger 2) at https://api.losant.com/.

Contact Support:
 Name: Losant Support
 Email: hello@losant.com
